name: Concert Girls
source:
[quote]You know, becoming an idol is not an easy task.[/quote]

This school is a place that specializes in training performers, from drama, singing, to agent training. He has all the expertise for the performers from front to back stage. You are committed to becoming a professional agent and hope to open your own agency one day.

[quote]Oh my God... This is really hard ....[/quote]

You meet lots of girls who are eager to become idols and entertainers, and they work hard to practice their skills, while you help them and learn how to become a competent agent. How will you guide these girls to the stage where they belong?

[quote]It's not only a game but a representation of youth, it's a dream.[/quote]

[From [url=https://enzo-work.itch.io/concert-girls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[quote]要知道，成为偶像并不是一件容易的事。[/quote]

这所学校是专门培养表演者的地方，从戏剧、歌唱、到经纪人培训。他拥有从台前到后台表演者的所有专业知识。你致力于成为一名专业代理人，并希望有一天能开设自己的代理机构。

[quote]天哪…这真的很难…[/quote]

你遇到了很多渴望成为偶像和艺人的女孩，她们努力练习自己的技能，而你帮助她们并学习如何成为一名称职的经纪人。你将如何带领这些女孩走向属于她们的舞台？

[quote]这不仅仅是一场游戏，更是青春的代表，是梦想。[/quote]

[来自[url=https://enzo-work.itch.io/concert-girls]itch.io[/url]]
